scope: Staging-only manual QA in the unpublished Tinker theme. No app deployment, theme publication, or Live/production action.

metafield.expected_value: Staging theme smoke: stainless steel, 500 g

checks.case: Theme editor supports adding Single field app block
checks.evidence: Tinker Default product > Product information > Details exposed the VSN | Metafields (Staging) Single field app block; block was added to the unpublished draft.

Entered Resource=Product, namespace=vsn_theme_smoke_20261009, key=material, label=Details using keyboard input; the storefront preview immediately rendered the exact value, Save reported changes saved, and a full editor reload preserved settings and rendering.
After keyboard input and saved draft reload, the Tinker product preview showed Details and the exact value 'Staging theme smoke: stainless steel, 500 g'.

Added Specifications to the Tinker product Details group, set Product resource, namespace vsn_theme_smoke_20261009, Field 1 key material and label Material. Preview rendered the exact value; after Save and full editor reload, the source/key/label and rendered value remained.
Tinker remains an unpublished staging draft; Publish was not clicked.
A schema-validated, read-only Admin GraphQL query returned the product metafield as single_line_text_field with the expected namespace, key and exact value.

limitations: This was manual UI verification on two unpublished themes; it does not certify full mobile/responsive/accessibility acceptance.
Specifications ordering, multiple instances, and full setting usability were not exhaustively tested.
No screenshot artifact was retained in the repository.
No app deployment, live deployment, theme publication, or production-data change was performed.
